author: delegate-eval
title: Cover the candidate ideology prompt with tests
body:
## Why

The candidate ideology classifier has no tests on its prompt. The abstain rule is the part that keeps us from putting a wrong label on a real candidate, and the no-outside-knowledge rule is the part legal asked for. Both are one careless edit away from being softened, and nothing would tell us.

These tests pin those rules in place so a rewrite that drops them fails CI, and they cover the one piece of logic in the builder: a section only shows up when the candidate filled it in.
diff:
diff --git a/packages/gp-api/src/campaignIdeology/campaignIdeology.prompt.test.ts b/packages/gp-api/src/campaignIdeology/campaignIdeology.prompt.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..889fbcc0d4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/gp-api/src/campaignIdeology/campaignIdeology.prompt.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import { buildCandidateIdeologyMessages } from './campaignIdeology.prompt'
+
+const empty = { issues: null, bio: null, background: null }
+
+describe('buildCandidateIdeologyMessages', () => {
+  it('tells the model to abstain instead of guessing', () => {
+    const [system] = buildCandidateIdeologyMessages(empty)
+
+    expect(system.content).toContain('Abstain freely.')
+    expect(system.content).toContain('Return bucket: null')
+    expect(system.content).toContain('never default to "moderate"')
+  })
+
+  it('forbids outside knowledge about the candidate', () => {
+    const [system] = buildCandidateIdeologyMessages(empty)
+
+    expect(system.content).toContain('Work only from the provided text.')
+    expect(system.content).toContain('Do not use any outside or general')
+    expect(system.content).not.toContain('party affiliation')
+  })
+
+  it('asks for cited evidence in a JSON-only reply', () => {
+    const [system] = buildCandidateIdeologyMessages(empty)
+
+    expect(system.content).toContain('Cite your evidence.')
+    expect(system.content).toContain('Respond with ONLY a JSON object')
+  })
+
+  it('includes only the sections the candidate filled in', () => {
+    const [, user] = buildCandidateIdeologyMessages({
+      ...empty,
+      issues: 'Fund the library',
+    })
+
+    expect(user.content).toContain('Fund the library')
+    expect(user.content).not.toContain('Why they are running')
+  })
+})
